passive.name: Sovereign's Domination
passive.desc: Enemies who fall before Viego become wraiths. By attacking a wraith, Viego temporarily seizes control of the dead enemy's body, healing for a percentage of his target's max health and gaining access to their basic abilities and items. He replaces their Ultimate with a free cast of his own.

spells.name: Blade of the Ruined King
spells.desc:
Viego's spectral blade passively deals bonus percent current Health damage On-Hit and strikes twice vs. enemies he recently hit with an Ability, stealing Health.

Viego can activate this Ability to thrust his zweihander forward, impaling enemies in front of him.

spells.name: Spectral Maw
spells.desc: Viego charges up before dashing forward, releasing a ball of concentrated Black Mist that stuns the first enemy hit.

spells.name: Harrowed Path
spells.desc: Viego commands the Black Mist to haunt and surround a piece of terrain. Viego can hide in the Mist as a wraith, gaining camouflage, Move Speed, and Attack Speed.

spells.name: Heartbreaker
spells.desc: Viego teleports to a nearby location and executes an enemy champion on arrival, piercing their heart and causing a destructive shockwave around them that knocks away their allies.
